dump_clip_features_pascal_part: dump CLIP text features for PASCAL-PART categories to a saved torch tensor file
run_clip_dog_only: run the script with --only_dog to generate CLIP features for dog part categories only
run_clip_prompt_photo: run the script with --prompt photo to use 'a photo of a {}' prompt templates for text encoding
run_clip_custom_output: run the script with --out_path to save CLIP text features to a custom output path
run_clip_rn101_model: run the script with --clip_model RN101 to use the ResNet-101 CLIP variant for text encoding
